def find_wcd(n, pairs):
    # Function to find the WCD of a list of pairs
    def sieve_of_eratosthenes(max_num):
        is_prime = [True] * (max_num + 1)
        p = 2
        while (p * p <= max_num):
            if (is_prime[p] == True):
                for i in range(p * p, max_num + 1, p):
                    is_prime[i] = False
            p += 1
        prime_list = [p for p in range(2, max_num + 1) if is_prime[p]]
        return prime_list

    def prime_factors(num, primes):
        factors = set()
        for prime in primes:
            if prime * prime > num:
                break
            while num % prime == 0:
                factors.add(prime)
                num //= prime
        if num > 1:
            factors.add(num)
        return factors

    # Collect all numbers from pairs
    all_numbers = set()
    for a, b in pairs:
        all_numbers.add(a)
        all_numbers.add(b)

    # Find the maximum number to limit the sieve
    max_num = max(all_numbers)

    # Get all prime numbers up to max_num using sieve
    primes = sieve_of_eratosthenes(max_num)

    # Calculate the WCD
    wcd_candidates = set()
    for a, b in pairs:
        a_factors = prime_factors(a, primes)
        b_factors = prime_factors(b, primes)
        common_factors = a_factors.intersection(b_factors)
        wcd_candidates.update(common_factors)

    # Check if there is any WCD greater than 1
    if not wcd_candidates:
        return -1

    # Return any WCD candidate
    return min(wcd_candidates)
